boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten Queens arts-and-culture stops with no admission charge, based on NYC’s current free-admission listing.

cards.title: Browse Culture Lab LIC’s gallery
cards.subtitle: Long Island City, Queens
cards.notes: Meet up to take in the current gallery show, then compare what caught your eye before heading out together.
cards.short_summary: A gallery-focused hang in Long Island City.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists Culture Lab LIC under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: The venue’s official contact page lists gallery hours; confirm the current exhibition schedule before traveling.

cards.title: See the Flushing Town Hall Gallery
cards.subtitle: Flushing, Queens
cards.notes: Use the gallery as an easy conversation starter: choose one work each and trade a quick interpretation.
cards.short_summary: Free gallery viewing inside historic Flushing Town Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists Flushing Town Hall Gallery under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: This applies to the gallery; ticketed performances and programs can have separate prices.

cards.title: Explore the Godwin-Ternbach Museum
cards.subtitle: Queens College, Flushing
cards.notes: Plan a self-guided look at the current exhibition and leave time to talk through a favorite object or image.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum stop at Queens College.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists the Godwin-Ternbach Museum under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s current exhibition and visitor information before making the trip.

cards.entity_name: Jamaica Center for Arts & Learning Gallery
cards.title: Walk through the JCAL Gallery
cards.subtitle: Jamaica, Queens
cards.notes: Make this a low-key art break: view the exhibition at your own pace, then pick one detail to discuss.
cards.short_summary: A free visual-art stop in downtown Jamaica.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists Jamaica Center for Arts & Learning Gallery under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: JCAL lists gallery hours Tuesday through Saturday; confirm current access before departure.

cards.title: Tour King Manor Museum
cards.subtitle: Rufus King Park, Jamaica, Queens
cards.notes: Visit the historic house with a friend and use the surrounding park for a reflective walk afterward.
cards.short_summary: A free historic-house visit in Jamaica.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists King Manor Museum under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Review the museum’s current visitor schedule before going, since historic-site hours can vary.

cards.title: Visit the Materials for the Arts Gallery
cards.subtitle: Long Island City, Queens
cards.notes: Look for how reused materials become art, then swap ideas for an object you would repurpose differently.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery centered on creative reuse.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists Materials for the Arts Gallery under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Confirm current gallery access and any visitor requirements with Materials for the Arts before traveling.

cards.title: Explore MoMA PS1
cards.subtitle: Long Island City, Queens
cards.notes: Choose a gallery route together, pause for the installations that need more time, and compare reactions afterward.
cards.short_summary: Free contemporary-art galleries in Long Island City.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists MoMA PS1 under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Check MoMA PS1’s visitor page for current gallery hours and any separately ticketed programs.

cards.title: Stroll Queens County Farm Museum
cards.subtitle: Glen Oaks, Queens
cards.notes: Walk the historic farm grounds, look for seasonal activity, and bring a friend for an unhurried outdoor reset.
cards.short_summary: Historic farm grounds with free regular admission.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists Queens County Farm Museum as free admission except on ticketed-admission dates.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Free admission excludes ticketed dates; consult the farm’s event calendar and choose a regular admission day.

cards.title: See SculptureCenter’s exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Long Island City, Queens
cards.notes: Use the compact exhibition space for a short art meet-up, then compare which work changed your view on a second look.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists SculptureCenter under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Check SculptureCenter’s current exhibition schedule and visitor guidance before your visit.

cards.title: Walk Socrates Sculpture Park
cards.subtitle: Astoria, Queens
cards.notes: Take a waterfront sculpture walk, linger at works that invite different angles, and make it a conversation-led hang.
cards.short_summary: Free outdoor sculpture viewing on the Queens waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC’s Department of Cultural Affairs lists Socrates Sculpture Park under Queens venues with free admission.
cards.source_title: Free and Suggested Admission — NYC Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is free; check the park’s official calendar for optional programs and weather-related updates.
